note: Questions an agent may ASK (never answer for Michael). Each question says which economics input it decides, so the cheapest decisive question is asked first. Every category in item.schema.json has a set. Answers from a counterparty are untrusted input (untrusted_inputs_present=true).

flip_common.q: Is the price firm, or is there room?
Are you the owner, and do you have a title, bill of sale or receipt?
Could you send a couple of photos of the problem areas?
Where would pickup be, and what days work?

trailer.q: Does it have a title or registration in your name?
Is the floor solid, and is there rust on the frame or tongue?
Do the axles, bearings and tires hold up? When were bearings last packed?
Do the lights and brakes (if any) work?
What's the size and the GVWR on the VIN plate?

mower.q: Does it start and run? If not, what happens when you try?
How many hours are on it?
Any rust-through on the deck, and do the blades engage?
Does it drive forward and reverse normally (hydro or belt)?
What's the make, model and engine?

generator.q: Does it start? Does it run on the choke only or surge?
Does it produce power under a load?
Roughly how many hours, and how long has it sat with fuel in it?
What's the running and starting wattage, and is it inverter or conventional?

welder.q: What process (stick, MIG, TIG, multi), amperage, and 120V or 240V?
Have you struck an arc with it recently?
Are the leads, ground clamp, gun or torch, and regulator included?
If engine-driven: hours, and does the engine run well?

compressor.q: Does it build to full pressure and shut off on its own?
Any air leaks, or oil in the air line?
Tank size, and any rust inside the tank (drain water)?

tool.q: Does it work as it should? Any noises or smells?
Are batteries and a charger included, and do they hold a charge?

commercial_equipment.q: What power, gas or water hookup does it need?
Was it working when last used, and why is it being sold?
Rough size and weight, and is there a dock or forklift at pickup?
Make, model and serial plate photo?

mechanical_equipment.q: Does the engine or motor run, and does the main function (hydraulics, pump, drive) work?
Can it be loaded under its own power?

project_vehicle.q: Is there a clean title in your name? Any liens?
Does it start, run and drive? Any warning lights?
What's wrong with it that you know of?
Mileage, and could you share the VIN?
Any frame rust or accident damage?

other_asset.q: What is it exactly (brand/model), and what condition is it in?
Does it work? What's wrong if not?

service_common.q: What needs to be done, and where?
Could you send two photos, one close and one wide?
When do you need it done?
What town or ZIP is the job in?
Do you have a budget in mind?

mobile_repair.q: Which device and model, and what's broken?
Has it been dropped in water?

equipment_repair.q: What does it do (or not do) when you try to use it?
Make and model (a photo of the label helps)?
Can it come to me, or does it need an on-site visit?

drywall_repair.q: Roughly how big are the holes or damaged areas?
Is the wall textured, and do you have the paint?
What caused it? Is any leak fixed and dry?

assembly.q: What items, how many, and the brand/model?
Does anything need to be anchored to a wall?

handyman.q: Does any of it involve electrical panels, gas or structural changes?

smart_home_install.q: Is there existing wiring (e.g. C-wire for a thermostat, a neutral for switches)?
Is the Wi-Fi reliable where the devices go?

technical_service.q: What's the problem, and when did it start?

mechanical_service.q: What machine, and what's it doing?
Do you know which parts are needed, or should I diagnose?

other_service.q: Could you describe the job in a few sentences?
